newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PetSec sees large potential reserves.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PetSec sees large potential reserves.

text.p: Petroleum Securities Australia Ltd said on Friday it has mapped potential reserves of 724 billion cubic feet of gas equivalent (bcfe), almost six times current net proved reserves of 123.2 bcfe.
Managing director Terry Fern told shareholders at the annual general meeting the potential reserves had been mapped using 3-D seismic on 28 lease blocks in the Gulf of Mexico.
The blocks contained 44 undrilled prospects, which would be drilled over the next three years.
"A lot of these have the same risk profile as the properties we have drilled up to now, and we have consistently understated our position by about 30 per cent," he told reporters after the meeting.
Fern said PetSec was generating sufficient funds from production to drill 13-15 wells a year and develop two or three new properties.
"We have enough money now to to spend A$70 million to A$100 million over the next three years to test our entire inventory," he said.
"We see a surge in reserves and a surge in production."
PetSec reported annual net profit after abnormal and extraordinary items of A$6.8 million in the year to June 30, 1996.
PetSec's shares were steady at A$5.70 at 2.40 p.m. (0340 GMT).
